_what: Which Triset subjects count as NATURE. REDONE 2026-08-31 on Sophie's correction ("they did a bad job of deciding what's nature and what's not. redo. things like castle, bridge yes nature, hail roof") — the first cut was read off the other chat's pages and drew the line at pure wilderness, which put castle, train-bridge and hail-roof on the wrong side along with pure-nature misses like daytime-moon, dandelion-seeds and duckling-swans. Her rule, from her three examples: NATURE is the OUTDOOR WORLD — landscapes, weather, sky, sea, plants, animals — including man-made things sitting out in it (a castle on a hill, a train bridge, hail on a tin roof, a hot air balloon over fields). NOT nature: indoor/domestic scenes, objects, food, human-stuff (a sock drawer, burnt toast, a hot tub, a cat at a fishbowl indoors). Used by gen-triset-hearts.js to partition her hearts across the nature and no-nature pages with nothing missing and nothing twice.
